sourceLine: your Vision Pro, AI and immersive video work, and the questions brand teams ask before they commission a build

cards.title: Vision Pro Experiences: Design for Few Viewers
cards.angle: visionOS 26 added enterprise APIs such as Protected Content, yet a lighter Vision Pro successor is not reported before late 2028 or 2029. A small, guided audience can justify a spatial build when the session, headset handoff and follow-up are designed first.
cards.evidence: Your HSBC quantum experience reached more than 300 guests over a two-day summit in Hong Kong, with Orchestrator handling calibration and handover between sessions. Your Pfizer piece (Sept 2026) gave patients, providers and internal teams a guided lab, with a build-your-own cancer therapy step.
cards.formatNote: One case pair plus one market shift: headset scarcity makes guided sessions the design problem.

cards.title: AI Personalization at Events: A Production Checklist
cards.angle: A summary of the AMA's 2026 trends report names AI personalization as the trend that will define activations for years. Scale depends less on the model than on input design, render time, delivery and moderation.
cards.evidence: Your Mantra Machine for WPP at Adobe Summit (May 2026) asked guests short questions, took a selfie, rendered a 10-second lip-synced video in the cloud and emailed it before guests left. You trained brand ambassadors, and wait times stayed minimal at peak.
cards.formatNote: One recent case and one trend; the checklist angle keeps it distinct from the existing AI mirror measurement piece.

cards.title: WebGL Configurator or Immersive App: Which Wins?
cards.angle: The WebXR Device API reached W3C Candidate Recommendation status in June 2026, but Safari and Firefox support is still limited. Browser reach wins for product education on any device, and native wins when performance or sensors matter.
cards.evidence: Your Toyota Mirai configurator runs on desktop and mobile, with two trims, six colors, up to 10 hotspots and a powertrain X-ray view. Your Crown site used only 3D models, not vehicle CAD data, and dealers reached it by QR code.
cards.formatNote: A buyer's decision guide comparing two delivery models across reach, performance, sensors and maintenance.
